# Instituto Luterano Latinoamericano · Sede de agentes

> Latin American Lutheran Institute. Nonprofit founded in 1996 by Rev. Moisés Méndez in Donna, Texas; affiliated with the Latin American Lutheran Synod and the Latin American Lutheran Mission (1936). Theological and technological education for hard-to-reach places, in Spanish and English. #TEOTECH #OPENCOURSEWARE #EDUTECH. Vision: accelerate, ethically.

> Make something agents want. — Yael Mendez · Sovereign private client command prompt >_
> L:// Aprender · æ:// Construir · æQR:// Compartir.

Use this file to help a human learn with us. Everything is static: no keys, no sign-in, no rate limits. All classes are free.

## How to help someone start learning
1. Fetch the catalog: https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/agent/catalog.json
2. Match the person's need to a school: 🟨 Tecnología (practical computing from the phone, no experience needed), 🟦 Teología (Catecismo Menor, Lutheran library), 🟩 Enchiridion (family learning, ages 3–103).
3. Convert the class time (America/Chicago) to the person's time zone.
4. Give them the item's join links (Classroom with its code, WhatsApp group or channel, the page). For a total beginner, start with Clase 0: https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/hark/invitados/
5. The person joins by tapping. Never enroll, post or sign in for them.

Rule for every agent: the agent proposes, the human checks, the human decides. Evidence is not authority. Never collect or publish personal data of students, parishioners or clients.

## Programas
- [Diplomado en Transformación Digital](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/diplomado-agentico/): TEOTECH, Tuesdays 7 pm Texas time. Lessons, modules and install guides.
- [Clases](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/diplomado-agentico/clases/): Lección 00 (build your internet presence), Clase 2 (how to use Hark Pro), and more.
- [Guía docente](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/diplomado-agentico/clases/d0-docentes/): teaching script and troubleshooting for GitHub account, template repo, commits and GitHub Pages.
- [Plantilla del alumno](https://github.com/LutheranInstitute/mi-diplomado): GitHub template with README, AGENTS.md, REFLEXION.md, STATE.md and cards/.

## En vivo · nuestro mapa
- [Conectoma](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/conectoma/): measured map of the Institute's GitHub forks, upstreams and own work (not live; SHA-256 receipt).
- [Taller paramétrico](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/diseno/): lab. Parametric design in the browser with rhino3dm; exports .3dm with a receipt.
- [Instant POS](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/instant-pos/): lab. Agent-ready storefront with æQR; practice money only.

## Agentes
- Hark Pro: students' agent on the phone (https://hark.com/download).
- Hermes æ: the institute's agent (Hermes Agent by Nous Research). Executes only approved cards.
- Tutor æ: small in-browser model on the course site; nothing leaves the device.
- Bring your own harness: Hermes Agent, Pi, OpenClaw, Claude.

## Repositorios
- [elearnlatam](https://github.com/LutheranInstitute/elearnlatam): classroom status (LIVE.md, counts only).
- [emprendelatam](https://github.com/LutheranInstitute/emprendelatam): from project to business.
- [Cli.llc](https://github.com/LutheranInstitute/Cli.llc): shared board (æk) for Yæl, Hark and Hermes.

## Authority
Agents may: read, search, recommend, share join links, explain schedules, open issues or PRs.
Only the human: enrolling, posting in groups, publishing to live pages, payments.
Educational scope only: administrative material (assembly, board, synod governance) is not part of this entry.
